title: Allocate a fixed test budget without hiding weak slices
description: Choose how a fictional 4-slice benchmark spends its item budget. The slice pass rates stay fixed so you can isolate how composition changes the headline and how sample size changes uncertainty.
note: All pass rates are illustrative pilot data, not claims about a real model or benchmark. The 95% intervals use the Wilson score method for binary outcomes.
